title: When the Persona Contradicts the Line: Diagnosing Plan-to-Synthesis Failures in Chain-of-Thought TTS
abstract: arXiv:2610.35008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought TTS systems rely on language-model planners to translate persona and context into vocal delivery, but it is unclear where this intent is lost when the requested affect conflicts with lexical sentiment. We introduce a bilingual Japanese--English persona--line conflict benchmark in which each item pairs one line with congruent and conflicting personas and pre-declares the expected acoustic direction. We probe this direction in the planner-generated delivery phrase, the planner-written emotion vector, the QwenEmotion-generated vector, and the rendered waveform. Planner outputs are usually direction-correct, while downstream agreement can be substantially lower. Bypassing QwenEmotion provides only modest gains over the full planner-controlled Base. translated_title: 当人设与台词相矛盾时：诊断思维链语音合成中从规划到合成的失效问题
translated_abstract: 思维链（Chain-of-Thought）语音合成（TTS）系统依赖语言模型规划器将角色人设与上下文转化为声音表达方式，但当所要求的情感与词汇本身的情感倾向发生冲突时，这一意图在何处丢失尚不清楚。我们构建了一个日语-英语双语的“人设-台词”冲突基准，其中每个条目将一句台词分别与一致和冲突的人设配对，并预先声明预期的声学方向。我们在规划器生成的表达短语、规划器写入的情感向量、QwenEmotion生成的情感向量以及最终渲染的波形中探测这一声学方向。结果表明：规划器的输出通常是方向正确的，而下游环节与预期方向的一致性却可能显著降低；绕过QwenEmotion相比完全由规划器控制的基础版仅有有限的提升；对QwenEmotion进行监督训练可将日语的方向正确率提升至75%、英语提升至84%；而学习式的文本到潜变量接口则达到了英语最高的89%以及最高的……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个日英双语人设-台词冲突基准，系统定位了思维链TTS中从规划到合成各环节的意图丢失问题，并证明监督情感分类器或采用学习式文本-潜变量接口可大幅提升声学情感方向的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a bilingual Japanese-English persona-line conflict benchmark to localize where intent is lost across plan-to-synthesis stages in chain-of-thought TTS, showing that supervising the emotion classifier or using a learned text-to-latent interface substantially improves acoustic direction consistency.
